cases.name: Nancy “Debbie” Love Belcher
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Debbie was a 1968 graduate of Sherman High School in Seth, WV. She graduated as a Registered Nurse from the University of Charleston in 1988. She was a dedicated and loving nurse who worked for CAMC for over 25 years.

Debbie attended Kanawha City Baptist Church. She enjoyed spending time with her beloved family and dogs. She was frequently seen walking her dogs in the community. Debbie faithfully collected “J” dollars to donate to the Children’s Cancer Society each month."

cases.name: Misty Rose Williams
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She was an employee of the Nitro Walmart and a former employee of the Southridge Home Depot. Misty enjoyed camping and fishing, but above all, she cherished the time she spent with her children, who were the center of her life."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot and killed her while she was in her car during her work break. Coworkers found her slumped over inside her car. Investigators said she died of a gunshot wound to the chest.
